newsitem.title: UK: Cookson profits ahead against weak markets.
newsitem.headline: Cookson profits ahead against weak markets.

text.p: Cookson Group Plc, the industrial material manufacturer, saw half year pretax, pre-exceptional profits jump five percent to 85.3 million against a backdrop of tough market conditions, it reported on Thursday.

Chairman Bob Malpas said "It has been a challenging six months, in which the majority of our businesses experienced difficult trading conditions." But despite weak markets in two thirds of Cookson's businesses, sales edged up six percent to 933 million stg in the half year to June 30. The dividend was up 11 percent at 3.9 pence.
